描述_EN: large hanging with a central vertical seam. the ground of the textile is red satin waeve silk and this is weft-patterned in various colours. the main field of the textile consists of large flower and foliage bands, while across the bottom is a narrow border of key-fret and small dragon bands. the hanging is lined with beige plain weave cotton. across the top is a broad border consisting of bands of key frets, small dragons and dragons with phoenixes. the pattern is arranged in three sections. there is a supplementary warp to bind the pattern wefts. there is a small handwritten paper label stuck on one corner of the lining. next to the paper label are two red characters stamped straight onto the lining
描述_ZN: 大挂，中央有竖缝。 纺织物的地面是红色的缎面海丝，这是由各种颜色的纬线图案组成的。 纺织物的主场由大的花和叶带组成，而横跨底部的是一个由钥匙扣和小龙带组成的窄边。 该挂毯以米色平纹棉布为衬。 横跨顶部的是一个宽阔的边框，由关键的雀斑、小龙和龙凤呈祥的带子组成。 图案分三部分排列。 有一个补充经线来绑定图案的纬线。 有一个小的手写纸标签贴在里子的一角。 在纸质标签的旁边有两个红色的字直接印在里子上。
